review_evidence: README explicitly describes the repository as a Lean 4 formalization of factorization systems.

All six primary files are formal library modules: Basic defines the FactorizationSystem structure, morphism-class closure predicates, slice constructions, and supporting lemmas; Characterization, Orthogonality, OrthogonalComplements and Examples develop the mathematical theory.
Direct source inspection found reusable category-theoretic definitions and proofs rather than build/test/application scaffolding, so no primary exclusion is justified.
summary: Retain FactorizationSystems in full as a substantive category-theory formalization.
